# Source provenance

The translation was prepared from the user-supplied archive:

```text
mgcv-master.zip
SHA-256: fb1ff5d9a43ddf306cb39465682b26a5b49f304002b4e5f612908d5620b43fc0
```

The archive identifies the source package as:

```text
Package: mgcv
Version: 1.9-4
License: GPL (>= 2)
Author and maintainer: Simon Wood
```

The translated `splines` dependency came from the previously prepared
`splines-fortran-v0.1.0.zip` artifact and is retained under
`dependencies/splines` with its own GPL-2.0-or-later license, notice, original
sources, tests, and documentation.

The complete R and C computational sources from the supplied `mgcv` archive
are retained under `original/R` and `original/src`; `DESCRIPTION`, `NAMESPACE`,
`ChangeLog`, and `MD5` are retained directly under `original/`.
